title: Upper moderate deviation probabilities for the maximum of a branching random walk
summary: Consider $M_n$ the maximal position at generation $n$ of a supercritical branching random walk. Aïdékon (2013) obtained and described the convergence in law, as time $n$ goes to infinity, of $M_n-m_n$, where $m_n$ is an explicit function. Equivalently, he identified the limit of $\mathbb{P}(M_n > m_n + x)$, for any $x \in \mathbb{R}$. More recently, Luo (2025) gave an asymptotic equivalent for the upper large deviation probability, that is $\mathbb{P}(M_n > m_n + xn)$, for $x > 0$.
